Where we travel in Da Nang

Sen Da Nang Massage comes to hotels, apartments, Airbnbs and villas across Da Nang, in My Khe, An Thuong, Son Tra, Hai Chau and Non Nuoc. Travel is free within these areas; further out (including Hoi An) we confirm any small fee on WhatsApp first.

    Son Tra peninsula, Man Thai and the resorts along the bay.

    City centre around the Dragon Bridge, Han Market and the riverside hotels.

    Dragon Bridge, Han Market, Bach Dang Riverside, Hai Chau 1 & 2

Massage in Da Nang: your questions

How do I book a massage at my hotel, apartment or villa?

Send us a WhatsApp message with your name, your hotel or property, your room or villa number, your preferred time and the treatment you'd like. A Google Maps pin helps too. We reply to confirm your booking and an estimated arrival time.

How much does an in-room massage cost?

Prices run from VND 450k for 60 minutes of foot reflexology to VND 1,500k for a 120-minute four-hands massage. Our recommended 90-minute Vietnamese traditional massage is VND 700k, and a 90-minute couple massage is VND 1,200k in total for two guests. Prices are in VND, travel within our areas is included, and you pay after the massage.

Can you come to my hotel room in Da Nang?

Yes. Many Da Nang hotels allow in-room massage from outside therapists. Let reception know you're expecting a massage therapist so they can send them up. Your therapist carries identification.

How soon can a therapist arrive?

A therapist typically arrives within 30-45 minutes in My Khe, An Thuong, Son Tra, Hai Chau and Non Nuoc. When you book, we give you an estimated arrival time on WhatsApp, and you can also book ahead for a later time or another day.

Is this a professional massage service?

Yes. Sen Da Nang Massage offers professional therapeutic massage only. Therapists will end a session straight away if a guest behaves inappropriately.

What does the therapist bring?

Fresh, clean linens and towels plus natural oils. You just need a bed or a quiet corner of your room. No massage table or special setup is needed.

What languages do the therapists speak?

Our therapists speak English and Vietnamese.

How and when do I pay?

After your massage, in cash (VND) or by bank transfer. There's no upfront deposit.

What are your opening hours?

Every day from 08:30 to 23:00, including weekends and public holidays.

Which areas of Da Nang do you cover?

My Khe and An Thuong, Son Tra, Hai Chau (city centre), and Non Nuoc near the Marble Mountains. Travel is free within these areas; for places further out we confirm any small travel fee on WhatsApp before booking.

Do you come to Hoi An?

On request, yes. Hoi An is outside our free-travel area, so we confirm the travel fee and arrival time on WhatsApp before booking.

Can I cancel or change my booking?

We would appreciate a quick message on WhatsApp if you need to cancel or reschedule your booking.
